name: Yuki Tanabe
want: keep the doors, drones and air working long enough for everyone to get out
secret: Two weeks ago she silenced the debris-shield fault alarms in Ops because they kept going off; she never logged them.
voice: Short, flat, practical; says exactly what's broken and how long it'll take.
description: Keeps Vesper's doors, drones and air running, and knows every crawlway. Sophia's favourite person to work with, and the other way round.
appearance: Compact and strong, hair shaved at the sides, a tool belt over her sleep shirt, a cut across her knuckles.
knows: Three weeks ago, on a night shift, she saw Maren at the reactor's local panel with a jumper cable across the rod interlock; Maren asked her not to mention it.
